name: Induce Pain
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism; Level: vitalist 0

MANIFESTING

Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Display: Visual

EFFECT

Range: 30 ft.
Target: 1 living creature
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: none; Power Resistance: yes
Power Points: psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

You attempt to cause a creature to feel pain. If you make a successful ranged touch attack at the target, it takes 1d3 points of damage.
